lanes.title: Fail-fast admission: replay lookup before the scope lock; lock every later write target NOWAIT; cancel race
lanes.description:
Second implement round on PR #580 (existing branch, head c5adabe). Binding: the coordinator decision comments on OVD-598 (c0997604 and the 2026-10-05 17:45Z amendment d0162954). Findings to resolve (details in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Overdrafter/b20cace5-8784-51f8-a7b4-1ed188995a77/scratchpad/run/findings/ovd598-nowait-impl-review.json):

(1) BLOCKING replay semantics: in migration 20261004100000 the NOWAIT helper runs at :122 before the replay/permit lookup (:124-127) and the deduplicated return (:148-165), so an exact replay of a dispatch whose original committed fails xometry_beta_job_busy whenever any scope row is held; the client then clears the uncertain-outcome recovery and says 'Nothing was queued' (false). Fix, server side (coordinator sign-off given): move the replay/permit lookup BEFORE the helper call so a dedup replay returns the existing permit without taking any row lock (as before this PR); the helper runs only on the non-replay path. Client side: reword the busy copy so it never claims nothing was queued (e.g. 'This part is being updated in another session. Try again in a moment.'); on xometry_beta_job_busy for an exact uncertain replay keep the attempt in status unknown so 'Check previous quote request' stays available; add the controller/ClientPart test for busy-on-replay; add a pgTAP assertion: replay while a worker holds a scope row returns the dedup result (same permitId), never busy.

(2) RESIDUAL CYCLE P1 (now in scope, coordinator decision): the request must hold, NOWAIT and before validation, every row lock it may need later at a strength sufficient for its later writes, so that after the scope locks it waits on nothing except the founding-beta shared advisory lock (whose only exclusive holder, admin enrollment, takes no row locks). Concretely: the job row FOR NO KEY UPDATE NOWAIT (replacing FOR SHARE; the final update of public.jobs status then needs no upgrade); the job's existing service_request_line_items rows FOR NO KEY UPDATE NOWAIT (the impl upsert target); and any other existing row the request path updates. ENUMERATE every UPDATE/DELETE/upsert target in api_request_xometry_beta_dispatch, private.request_scoped_automatic_quote_impl (20260812044000) and the triggers they fire, and show in the PR body that each existing-row target is pre-locked NOWAIT and each insert is a fresh row with no uncommitted unique-key competitor (quote-lane-submit per job serializes same-job admissions). Parts, requirements and job_files stay FOR SHARE NOWAIT (the request only reads them). Add R6: the api_cancel_quote_request interleaving (P1 from the previous implementer notes): no 40P01 on either side; the cancel waits on the request then completes, or the request fails busy. Red first: R6 reproduces the 40P01 at c5adabe.

(3) Text: Sonar group-2 count 34 (lines incl. :161, :182, :189, :203, :207, :304, :429, :638); pins wording (two pinned fixture files plus three race entries; README and expected-results are documentation only); wait-analysis wording (the generic request is serialized with the legacy request by the quote-lane-submit advisory lock; preview and preflight take only shared modes); the migration header (:24-27), the OVD-598 issue and the PR body must state the precise claim: after taking its NOWAIT locks the request waits only on the founding-beta shared advisory lock.

Update the OVD-598 description (patch the amended criteria: add R6 and the lock-set statement) and the rolling comment; refresh the PR body (head, evidence, static pins for FOR NO KEY UPDATE NOWAIT and the lookup order). Re-pin the profile content hash again. Merge-forward into claude/server-empty-file-upload-rejection (#592) and push.
lanes.guidance: Existing branch and draft PR #580; never rebase, amend or force-push. If `git checkout -B` reports the branch is checked out in another worktree, work detached at origin/<branch> and push with `git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/<branch>`. Lockfiles follow #564 (/home/user/wt/base564 symlinks). Run ensure-docker.sh then `supabase status`; DB work under /tmp/ovd-supabase.lock; keep locked sections short. Do NOT kill other agents' processes (no pkill by pattern; kill only your own PIDs). Static test: pin the lookup-before-helper order, FOR NO KEY UPDATE NOWAIT on jobs and line items, FOR SHARE NOWAIT on the rest, the 55P03 handler, and the byte-for-byte remainder of the request body. Keep the lifecycle-race fixture expectations consistent (re-run node --test scripts/free-quote-psql-races.node-test.mjs and the profile tests). Never write the release-parent identifiers listed in ENV.md.
lanes.failure_first: Red at c5adabe: (a) replay-while-worker-open returns xometry_beta_job_busy instead of the dedup result (scratch probe REPLAY 4 from the review); (b) R6 cancel interleaving reproduces 40P01 (previous implementer probe P1, artifacts under scratchpad/u598/). After the change both are green. Mutations on scratch copies only: move the helper back before the lookup -> (a) red again; drop the line-item lock -> R6 red again.
lanes.verification: flock /tmp/ovd-supabase.lock sh -c 'supabase db reset --local && supabase test db --local supabase/tests/xometry_beta_dispatch_admission_serialization.sql'; full supabase test db --local under the lock (capability_runtime_persistence_concurrency.sql is environment-only); npx vitest run src/features/quotes/xometry-admission-lock-migration.test.ts src/features/quotes/xometry-beta-dispatch.test.ts src/pages/ClientPart.test.tsx; node --test scripts/free-quote-ci-profile.node-test.mjs scripts/free-quote-psql-races.node-test.mjs; node scripts/generate-free-quote-fixtures.mjs --check; npm run verify:migration-lineage; npm run lint && npm run typecheck; flock /tmp/ovd-verify.lock npm run verify (worker/src/recovery/browserRecovery.test.ts root-sandbox failure is a known environment baseline; run build and verify:worker separately). Hosted (authoritative): free-quote-sql, test, ovd591 jobs, Sonar at the new head.
